source:
@@U04671@@
but try, won't you,
a smile, just one, one smile,
one I'll never forget!
A lover’s look, don’t you know,
a little, very little twist of the mouth.
Oh, you long-legged beauty you,
it’s you I like best! Except that clerical look;
it doesn’t suit you.
Try something a soupcon more lascivious.
And you all could show a bit more flesh;
those long pleated robes, ah! are much too moral.
They're turning!
Ah, the rascals!
Ah!
A view from the rear!
From behind, ah,
they’re far, far too delectable!

@@U04673@@
Flames of love, hasten,
Grow ever clearer;
To the self-damned
Bring holiness nearer,
So that from evil
They may be free,
And in the Great Unity
Transformed may be.

@@U04675@@
(Pulling himself together.)

@@U04676@@
What’s happened to me?
All over me, boils,
boils head to foot, like Job!
I shudder at the sight!
And yet—
and yet I triumph, seeing through it all,
and put trust in myself and my family tree!
This Devil’s noble parts are still intact.
translation:
@@U04671@@
但尝试一下，不是吗
一个微笑，只有一个，一个微笑，
我永远不会忘记的一个！
恋人的样子你不知道吗
嘴角轻轻一扭。
哦，长腿美女你，
我最喜欢的是你！除了那副文书的样子；
它不适合你。
尝试一些更淫荡的汤。
你们都可以多露一点肉；
那些长褶袍，啊！太道德了。
他们转身了！
啊，无赖们！
啊!
从后面看的景色！
从后面看，啊，
它们太美味了！

@@U04673@@
爱的火焰，快点，
变得越来越清晰；
致自责者
让圣洁更近，
以便远离邪恶
他们可能是自由的，
而在大团结之中
改造可能是。

@@U04675@@
（振作起来。）

@@U04676@@
我怎么了？
我浑身上下都长满了脓疮
从头到脚都沸腾了，就像约伯一样！
看得我不寒而栗！
然而——
但我胜利了，看穿了这一切，
相信我自己和我的家谱！
这个恶魔的高贵部分还完好无损。
